reviews.text: This is a veterinarian I've been indebted to for over 10 years. Thanks to him, my cat lived a long life, and he was a wonderful veterinarian who took great care of my family.

I used to take my dog ​​there for treatment.

Even when my dog's life was in danger, and after he passed away, the doctor would cry while repeatedly performing CPR. He was a very humane and warm doctor.

They responded immediately, and I'm very grateful for their help☆
The examination was thorough☆
The waiting time wasn't a problem at all☆
The doctor and reception staff are very kind☆
He is a very kind doctor. I feel at ease when consulting him about anything. He treats pets from the owner's perspective.

I'm a regular customer.

I had my dog ​​groomed today. They did a lovely job, and I'd like to use their services again.

This doctor is very caring and considerate of cats!

I used their after-hours clinic. There aren't many hospitals that offer after-hours care, so it was a great help.

My cat got into a fight with another cat at home and got a wound near its ear that burst with pus.

Since the doctor was working alone at night, I held the cat down, drained the pus, cleaned and disinfected the wound. They prescribed an ointment, which I applied morning and evening. A week later, I went back for a check-up and my cat was completely healed. Thank you so much. I'll definitely come back if anything happens.

There's no parking lot, so I parked in a nearby coin-operated parking lot.

I always take my pet to this vet.

They also offer pet hotel services, which is very convenient.

Thank you for your continued support.

I stopped by today for a vaccination.
The explanation was clear and thorough.

I'm so grateful that I could get my pet seen so quickly.

The diagnosis was accurate, and I feel confident bringing my pet here.

This is truly my pet's go-to vet.

I am always grateful for your help. You are open late and on holidays, so it is easy to visit, and when I am unsure whether I should be seen, you are always available to give me advice over the phone, which is very helpful.

He is an excellent veterinarian. My three elderly miniature dachshunds are under his care. Last year, Marie, the second oldest, developed a splenic tumor. She suddenly became ill, and when we rushed her to see him, he arranged for a blood transfusion and saved her life through emergency surgery. Her post-operative recovery was good, but about three months later, she developed a herniated disc. We immediately took her to Dr. Sugimoto, who referred us to the Aikawa Animal Medical Center, which specializes in treating herniated discs in animals, and we were able to have surgery there. Her post-operative recovery was also good, and she is now happily running around the yard.

His diagnoses, medications, and treatments are all accurate, but what I think is most wonderful is the deep love and care he shows towards animals. There's not a trace of profit-seeking in him, and you can feel completely at ease. I recommend him with confidence.

We've been going to this clinic since our dog was born. The head veterinarian is very friendly and straightforward. He answers questions thoroughly, showing photos and data, which makes us trust him.

On Thursdays, a dermatologist comes in and provides accurate diagnoses. She's a wonderful female veterinarian who speaks kindly to dogs and is very supportive of families. Our dog has benefited greatly from her accurate diagnoses, and we are truly grateful. Knowing that we can see this dermatologist if anything happens is a huge advantage.

There's a Sugi Pharmacy right in front of the clinic, which is convenient for parking (30 minutes with a 500 yen purchase, 1 hour with a 1000 yen purchase).

However, the reception staff and groomers change frequently while I'm going there. It's a bit concerning that there aren't many long-term staff members.
Although I don't visit very often, I've been using your services since moving here. I feel at ease because you examine me so carefully. Thank you for your continued support.

Thank you for your continued support.

The doctor and nurses are all kind and gentle, making me feel at ease during my appointments!
My children are always well cared for here. I appreciate how kindly you examine them; I feel completely at ease leaving them in your care.
I received the vaccine. Thank you very much!

They offer thorough examinations nearby.

And they also have grooming services, so it's great to have one-stop care.

Highly recommended.

Since opening the practice, I have been taking care of my previous dog, Tama, and my second dog, Meimei. The doctor is very considerate and gives advice to my dogs, and I rely on the sense of security and trust that comes with being in a private practice. Today, since it was warm, I had my dog ​​tested for heartworm and was prescribed medication to prevent fleas and ticks!

Last year, the day before the New Year's holiday, I had severe diarrhea with bloody stools, so I was given medicine and an IV drip.
However, even though the holiday was starting the next day, they said they would come to the clinic every day, so if I left a message on their answering machine, they would contact me and come see me.
Fortunately, the medicine cured me, and those words reassured me as I welcomed the New Year.

The doctor is always smiling and answers all questions carefully. The hospital has a bright atmosphere, including the staff, so I'm grateful that my dog ​​can come for checkups without feeling stressed.
I'm truly grateful to the head veterinarian for always being so kind and smiling. My cats are absolutely thrilled!

I didn't sense any expertise from the director, and it seemed like the doctor didn't particularly like small animals. It was an unpleasant experience. I won't be getting my cat treated here again.
My cat had been vomiting constantly due to gastroenteritis, and had just been neutered a few days prior. The doctor suggested I consult a neuter specialist. The doctor then prepared an IV drip for the cat. I tried to comfort him during the drip, but the doctor stopped me, saying, "You're a nuisance in the examination room." As a result, the cat reacted violently and the drip didn't go well. The doctor then decided to give the cat an injection, but when I asked what it was, he simply replied coldly, "It's stomach medicine."
Fortunately, I received specialized treatment at another hospital the next day.

Elf Dog School trusts him as a professional dog trainer. 
In addition to providing thorough examinations, he also helps train dogs that get violent during examinations.

They always listen to my concerns attentively and give me accurate advice.

Also, I appreciate that they're open late, so I can bring my pet in even after work.

I've used their pet hotel and grooming services several times, and both were great!
They will explain any questions clearly and carefully. The nurses are also very kind and I've always been grateful for their care. They also offer night-time medical care, which is reassuring.

I've been a patient here for over 10 years. When my dog ​​fractured a toe, they gave me instructions over the phone even outside of regular hours and referred me to a specialist for advanced treatment the next day. When there were dental …
Our previous dog was sick and we had to take care of him for many years. Our second dog is doing well thanks to you.
